label: v_retrieval rows
sql: SELECT session_id,timestamp,query_text,query_type,slug,title,rank,final_score,q_score,ucb_bonus,transport FROM v_retrieval ORDER BY rank LIMIT 20

label: v_retrieval transport distribution
sql: SELECT transport, COUNT(*), MIN(session_id), MAX(session_id) FROM v_retrieval GROUP BY transport

label: raw retrieval_log count vs view
sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retrieval_log) AS raw, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_retrieval) AS view_rows, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM retrieval_log) AS raw_sessions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_session) AS view_sessions

label: v_retrieval slug/title non-null
sql: SELECT SUM(slug IS NULL) AS null_slug, SUM(title IS NULL) AS null_title, SUM(query_text IS NULL) AS null_q, SUM(query_type IS NULL) AS null_qt, SUM(rank IS NULL) AS null_rank, SUM(final_score IS NULL) AS null_fs, SUM(q_score IS NULL) AS null_qs, SUM(ucb_bonus IS NULL) AS null_ucb, COUNT(*) AS n FROM v_retrieval

label: v_retrieval join v_note on slug
sql: SELECT r.slug, r.rank, n.pagerank FROM v_retrieval r JOIN v_note n USING(slug) ORDER BY r.rank LIMIT 5

label: SELECT * FROM v_retrieval NATURAL JOIN v_note count
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_retrieval NATURAL JOIN v_note

label: v_stage NATURAL JOIN v_retrieval (shared session_id+timestamp)
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_stage NATURAL JOIN v_retrieval
